hits.draft_en:
I keep catching myself waiting for the shop to be finished before I enjoy the desk.

The typewriter logo is already chosen. The teal / cream / ember is set. The plain page is sitting here.

What's stopping me from writing on it today? Not much, honestly. Just the habit of saving the good part for later.

reply_ideas.reply_text: This one sat with me. I've been waiting for the shop to feel finished before I enjoy the desk. The page is already here. What's stopping me from writing on it today? Not much.
Still sitting with this. I've been optimizing for a busy-looking week. Trying the long-term version instead — same pen, same plain page, again tomorrow.

I've been keeping a small pile of proof since yesterday's post — kind messages, a quiet desk photo, a page that went somewhere. Opening it when the day feels thin. Not to fix anything. Just to remember.
The pattern is the proof — that line stuck. Trust as the quiet side effect of showing up the same way. One honest page, again, has been enough for me.
